name: Content and asset tagging
description: Tag a content library by persona and funnel stage so it can be found, reported on and reused. Edit personas to match yours.

persona.instructions: Who is this asset mainly written for?

criteria.executive: Senior leaders deciding on budget and strategy
criteria.practitioner: Hands-on users doing the work day to day
criteria.technical: Engineers, IT or security reviewers evaluating fit

funnel_stage.instructions: Which buying stage does this asset serve best?

criteria.awareness: Explains a problem or trend; doesn't mention our product much
criteria.consideration: Compares approaches or explains how our kind of solution works
criteria.decision: Proves our product specifically: case studies, ROI, pricing, security
criteria.retention: Helps existing customers get more value
